'''Paul Todd Feldman Cheap Cloud City Trooper Deck''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/CC.html Cheap Cloud City Trooper Deck], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991104014656/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/CC.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bespin: Cloud City (Dark)|CC-D-bespincloudcity.gif|label=Bespin: Cloud City}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City drain
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Feldman DS CC Trooper Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
Feldman built it "for the advanced player". It drains in the [[Clouds]], piles troopers at the Security Tower and Dining Room, and uses [[Stunning Leader]] with [[Trooper Assault]]. He listed its weakness as power space and ground with no interrupts.<ref name="torch" />
